personal.title: Send a personal invitation
personal.text: Hey! I’m part of CHOSEN: The Story Before the Manger, and I’d really love to see you there. It’s a Christmas story about courage, faith, and hope, told through music, dance, and drama. It’s Sunday, December 20 at 6 PM at The Faith Center in Sunrise, and admission is free. Would you like to come? Here are the details: https://fcustard.github.io/chosen-2026-company-hub/chosen.html

whatsapp.title: Cast WhatsApp announcement — ready to send
whatsapp.text:
Hey CHOSEN family! Our “Come See Me in CHOSEN” flyers are ready!

Find your name and save your Post and Story flyers here:
https://fcustard.github.io/chosen-2026-company-hub/cast-flyers.html

Our launch week is November 9–15. Here’s the goal:
• Share your Post flyer once.
• Share your Story flyer twice.
• Personally invite five people.

Pick a caption for your friends, a Christmas outing, or the story’s message. Video prompts and the sharing plan are here:
https://fcustard.github.io/chosen-2026-company-hub/cast-launch-kit.html

Send your guests this show link:
https://fcustard.github.io/chosen-2026-company-hub/chosen.html

The show is Sunday, December 20 at 6 PM at The Faith Center. Admission is free!

Parents and guardians, please help your child share. If you spot a flyer mistake or cannot find your name, let Ms. Lounise know before posting. Use the kit’s response tracker to record your posts, invitations, replies, and people who say they plan to come. Let’s invite our people!

church.title: Church announcement — draft for the media team
church.text: Make room for hope this Christmas. Before the manger, Mary and Joseph faced choices that required courage and faith. Experience their journey through music, dance, and drama in CHOSEN: The Story Before the Manger. Join us Sunday, December 20, 2026 at 6 PM at The Faith Center, 5555 NW 95th Avenue in Sunrise. Admission is free. Bring someone you love. Save the date at https://fcustard.github.io/chosen-2026-company-hub/chosen.html

video.title: A short video invitation
video.text:
“One thing this story is teaching me is…”

Finish that sentence in your own words. Then add:

schedule.detail: Choose the personal-connection caption for people who know you. Share your Post flyer and first Story with the guest link.
Send five personal invitations. Record how many people reply and how many say they plan to come.
Use the shared-experience Story: Make room for hope this Christmas. Add the guest link.
Choose a personal video prompt. Record one honest thought and your invitation at home or at your next scheduled call.
Reply to interested people. Offer directions and the calendar link. Update your response tracker using actual replies.
Share an approved rehearsal glimpse, costume detail, or personal invitation video. Give this post a different purpose from your flyer.
Record your Post, Stories, invitations, replies, and people planning to attend. Export your totals for the coordinator. Leave unavailable link-click counts blank.

guest_page.hook: Before the manger, there was a choice to trust.
guest_page.story_lead: They could not see the whole journey. They chose to trust anyway.
guest_page.story: Before the manger, Mary and Joseph faced a future they could not fully see. Follow their journey of courage, faith, and trust through music, dance, and drama in CHOSEN: The Story Before the Manger.
guest_page.share_text: Make room for hope this Christmas. Join me for CHOSEN: The Story Before the Manger on December 20, 2026 at 6 PM at The Faith Center in Sunrise. Free admission. Bring someone you love.
